payload.final_recommendation: The procurement plan for the €10 million budget will allocate 30% (€3 million) to supplies, with the remaining 70% (€7 million) to be allocated to services due to the works specialist rejecting the request as out of scope. No contracts for works will be awarded. For supplies, the budget will be divided into 10 lots, each with a budget share of 3% (€200,000), ensuring no single lot exceeds the EU threshold and aligning with sustainability criteria. The award criterion for supplies will be a best price-quality ratio, with weights of price 70% and quality 30%. Services will be re-evaluated to ensure they are within the CPV divisions 50 to 98. The works specialist declined the request due to it being out of scope, and no figures are used from their proposal.
